title: The Coats’ Homecoming
description: At the cleaners’ autumn homecoming, forgotten coats leave their hangers to find their owners. A blue overcoat recognizes the woman waiting at the door.
alt: An empty blue wool coat floats out of a warmly lit dry cleaner and reaches a sleeve toward an older woman. Two smaller coats hover behind it.
pairing: A late-autumn homecoming × forgotten coats that find their owners
